headline_constraints.consequence: This column MUST be bound at DAY precision, and this mapping binds it that way. Binding it at the precision its text displays would let the engine sequence two events by manufactured minutes -- imputation entering through a format string rather than through a missing value, and invisible to every check downstream of here. Whatever precedence the source's sub-day component appears to give between these two columns is not evidence and must never be promoted to INFERRED.
headline_constraints.measurement: 170,782 of 180,519 evaluable rows match exactly (94.6061%); the rows that do not match are displaced by +12h (5,080 rows), -12h (4,657 rows)
headline_constraints.statement: `shipping date (DateOrders)` IS NOT AN INDEPENDENTLY OBSERVED INSTANT. Its value equals `order date (DateOrders)` plus `Days for shipping (real)` whole days, to the minute, in 94.6061% of evaluable rows. Its sub-day component was therefore COPIED, not measured, and any sequencing that reads it is reading a number the source manufactured.

headline_constraints.consequence: For those rows the two events cannot be sequenced from the data at all. Any edge between them is UNDETERMINED and is blocked from promotion to INFERRED (ADR-0021). A ranking that appears to sequence them is showing a sort key, not a precedence claim.
headline_constraints.statement: The declared precedence pair PLACEMENT_BEFORE_DISPATCH is temporally INSEPARABLE in 5,080 rows: both instants fall in the same interval.

not_checked: **Semantic correctness of the mapping.** That a column is bound to the RIGHT ontology concept is not checkable here and is not checked anywhere. A mapping that validates cleanly can still be wrong, and it would produce silently wrong causality rather than an error. This is risk R-16.
**Whether the source data is TRUE.** Profiling measures what the file says, not whether the file is right about the world.
**Persistence.** No fact was written to PostgreSQL: module 4 (Event Generator) does not exist, so there are no Events to persist. This import ends at the clean layer and this report.
**Causal accuracy.** There is no causal ground truth in this dataset (CONVENTIONS.md §14), so nothing here or downstream can measure it.

**MAP-N-DERIVED-OCCURRENCE-DEFERRED** (event_types[PAYMENT_REVIEW_OPENED]): is declared DERIVED, so its occurrence is reconstructed rather than read from a column; coverage of its instant was NOT CHECKED here => Module 4 derives this event and its interval from Implied by an Order Status of PAYMENT_REVIEW, SUSPECTED_FRAUD or ON_HOLD. No column records who opened the review or when. Whether that derivation is sound is risk R-16 and is checked by nothing in this repository.

**MAP-N-DERIVED-OCCURRENCE-DEFERRED** (event_types[SHIPMENT_DELAYED]): is declared DERIVED, so its occurrence is reconstructed rather than read from a column; coverage of its instant was NOT CHECKED here => Module 4 derives this event and its interval from Implied by Days for shipping (real) exceeding Days for shipment (scheduled), and corroborated by a Delivery Status of LATE_DELIVERY. Both columns are real; the occurrence they describe is not separately recorded, and the dataset gives no moment at which the delay became apparent. Whether that derivation is sound is risk R-16 and is checked by nothing in this repository.

**MAP-N-DERIVED-OCCURRENCE-DEFERRED** (event_types[SHIPMENT_DELIVERED]): is declared DERIVED, so its occurrence is reconstructed rather than read from a column; coverage of its instant was NOT CHECKED here => Module 4 derives this event and its interval from Implied by a Delivery Status other than SHIPPING_CANCELED together with a non-negative Days for shipping (real). The arrival itself is never logged. Whether that derivation is sound is risk R-16 and is checked by nothing in this repository.

**MAP-N-DERIVED-OCCURRENCE-DEFERRED** (event_types[SHIPMENT_DISPATCHED]): is declared DERIVED, so its occurrence is reconstructed rather than read from a column; coverage of its instant was NOT CHECKED here => Module 4 derives this event and its interval from THE CASE THE PRD NAMES. DataCo carries a shipping date column and no dispatch record. The date is strong evidence that a dispatch occurred and is not itself the occurrence, so the occurrence is declared here as DERIVED with the date as its basis. A pack that called this OBSERVED would put a fabricated fact into the system of record with a real column standing behind it, which is the most convincing kind of wrong. Whether that derivation is sound is risk R-16 and is checked by nothing in this repository.

**MAP-N-DERIVED-OCCURRENCE-DEFERRED** (event_types[SHIPMENT_IN_TRANSIT]): is declared DERIVED, so its occurrence is reconstructed rather than read from a column; coverage of its instant was NOT CHECKED here => Module 4 derives this event and its interval from Implied by a positive Days for shipping (real) on a dispatched order. DataCo contains no tracking scan of any kind, so this event type marks an interval rather than a moment and carries a low temporal support. Whether that derivation is sound is risk R-16 and is checked by nothing in this repository.
